definitions.explanation: how to use; usage; way of using

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}の{使|つか}い{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to use this machine.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{方|かた}を{間違|まちが}えると{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous if you use it incorrectly.

examples.japanese: {敬語|けいご}の{使|つか}い{方|かた}は{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The usage of honorific language is difficult.

notes:
{使|つか}い{方|かた} combines the stem of {使|つか}う (to use) with {方|かた} (way, method), meaning "way of using" or "how to use."

The ~{方|かた} pattern is highly productive:
- {食|た}べ{方|かた} (how to eat)
- {書|か}き{方|かた} (how to write)
- {作|つく}り{方|かた} (how to make)
- {読|よ}み{方|かた} (how to read; pronunciation)

Common expressions:
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}がわからない (don't know how to use)
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}を{覚|おぼ}える (to learn how to use)
- {正|ただ}しい{使|つか}い{方|かた} (correct usage)
